## Baker Hughes Declares Quarterly Dividend


10/27/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 1.02 MB](https://s21.q4cdn.com/548121662/files/doc_news/Baker-Hughes-Declares-Quarterly-Dividend-9b1492e78-2026.pdf)


HOUSTON and LONDON, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR) announced today that the Baker Hughes Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share of Class A common stock payable on Nov. 20, 2026, to holders of record on Nov. 10, 2026.


Baker Hughes expects to fund its quarterly cash dividend from cash generated from operations.


**About Baker Hughes:**
Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR) is an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
